Stylizer VSTi will feature sampled sound font banks.
Stylizer VSTi will start with two generic style banks, each consisting of 128 randomly selected styles.

The project will use, edit, and re-sample public domain general midi banks to add to their own sampled library called 'mostly solo instruments'.
The sampling process is currently 10% done and is expected to take no more than 2 months.
The project aims to add realistic velocity switched samples to the provided sound banks for the first two style's generic banks.
The work for composing and arranging styles has already started with a list of enthusiastic musicians for the first two banks.
